name: Air Defender: Start Test
description: Closes the moving-head shutters for the given time, on this FPP and, if it is the master, on every Remote, then hands them back to the sequence. The same as Start Test on the dashboard.

name: Air Defender: Check Now
description: Checks for aircraft for the given number of minutes even outside show times, for example while testing a sequence. 0 ends it early. The same as Check now on the dashboard.

args.name: Minutes
args.description: How long to check (minutes, 0 ends it)
